newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-HIH says S&P affirms AA-minus rating.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-HIH says S&P affirms AA-minus rating.

text.p: HIH Winterthur International Holdings Ltd said on Monday its AA-minus claims paying ability rating had been affirmed by Standard and Poor's Corp.
The insurance firm, which is 48 percent owned by Winterthur Swiss, said the rating was first assigned in November 1995 when it acquired CIC Insurance Ltd.
It said the rating applied to the main underwriting entities of the insurance group, namely HIH Casualty nd General Insurance Ltd and CIC Insurance.

"HIH Winterthur should continue to demonstrate solid premium growth and sound earnings performance, underpinned by organic growth, expansioning ventures, and completion of the integration of the CIC Insurance business," HIH quoted S&P as saying in its report on the company. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
